methods.description: Use whole-number place value to multiply by10,100 or1000, placing zeros in the empty places.

Write the multiple as a one-digit factor times10,100 or1000; use the known product first, then place value, retaining any zero already in that product. Use the products to explain an error or compare results when asked.
